items.rule: Do not buy any contract priced 90 to 95 cents. Wins 92.3% but needs 93.2% to break even, and the losses are bigger bets.
Turn off XRP bets. The loss is large enough to be real, not luck.
Keep the 15-minute favourites strategy off. It wins 95.0% of the time but needs 96.6% to break even.
Pause the Value strategy. It wins 75% and is losing; only 40 bets, so not proven.
Keep Solana bets small and watch them. Slightly negative, but luck could explain it.
Keep HYPE bets small and watch them. Slightly negative, but luck could explain it.
